method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (page 2) exists and is entirely BLANK - a real zero, not a gap. The empty schedule equals the cover's line-1 THIS REPORT cell, a written 0, EXACTLY. SCOPE IS PERIOD, NOT CUMULATIVE, AND THAT MATTERS HERE: the line-1 CUMULATIVE cell reads 97.36 (carried from the earlier report of this cycle, which is not in my chunk), so the empty schedule matches the THIS cell and NOT the cycle-to-date figure the module publishes. Line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate, never itemized) reads 0 in the THIS column and is left blank in both the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns. The Carr form prints no schedule total; the cover is the only anchor.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 3) exists and is entirely BLANK - a real zero. The empty schedule equals the cover's line-3 THIS REPORT cell, a written 0, EXACTLY; the CUMULATIVE cell reads 543.06, so again the rows are on PERIOD scope, not on the published cycle-to-date figure. Form B prints no schedule total.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither Carr schedule prints a total or a page subtotal - stated, not invented. Both schedules are blank, so the only gate available is against the cover: p2 rows 0.00 = cover line 1 THIS (written 0); p3 rows 0.00 = cover line 3 THIS (written 0).
gates.row_count: Not run with rowbands.py - zero data rows to count. Both ruled sheets were read at 200 dpi full-page and carry NO filer ink at all; the marks visible on p2 and p3 are MIRROR-IMAGE show-through of the printed statute text from page 4 (heavy on p3, lighter on p2), typeset and reversed, not handwriting. No ghost row was transcribed.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, AND THE CAUSE IS THE FILER'S OWN ARITHMETIC. Carr cover has no beginning-balance line. Taking the CUMULATIVE column: 97.36 (line 1) + blank (line 2) - 543.06 (line 3) = -445.70, but the printed line-4 CUMULATIVE balance reads 640.42. 640.42 is exactly 97.36 + 543.06 - the filer ADDED his contributions and his expenses instead of subtracting, so his 'balance' is a gross total, not cash on hand. Both figures retained verbatim; nothing recomputed and nothing overwritten. LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE does hold on lines 1 and 3 (97.36 + 0 and 543.06 + 0). No second Zilles filing for this cycle is in my chunk, so no cross-filing chain test was possible; the earlier report that produced the 97.36 / 543.06 LAST-column figures is not one of my documents.

escalation_note: 1200 dpi crops of the cover's LAST-REPORT and CUMULATIVE money columns; the schedules needed none (no ink to escalate).
